title: Second Handbook of the Garrote Loop
summary: Carries the loop throw into qi-guided work, closing the loop on a moving neck and holding it shut.

title: Drill-Book of the Qi-Charged Cord
summary: Drills charging the cord with qi so it serves as rigid guard, sawing edge and humming restraint.

title: A Treatise on Cord Tension and Release
summary: Explains how a garrote user raises tension by degrees, goes slack on purpose and turns the target's heave against them.

title: The Toggle-Handle Method
summary: Teaches working the garrote through its two wooden handles as hooks, jabs, belt anchors and weaving points.

title: Workbook of the Stalking Garrote
summary: Sets out the silent approach, the hidden cord and qi-muffled footfall that bring a garrote user behind a target.

title: Principles of the Whip-Back Pull
summary: Teaches the backward arm heave, hip thrust and spine arch that give the garrote its full lifting force.

title: The Warrior's Cord Discipline
summary: Builds a warrior's wide stance and even qi draw so the cord can be held steady and steered like a rein.

title: Notes on Wire Against Guarded Throats
summary: Shows how a stiffened wire finds a way past tucked chins, gorgets and armor seams.
